title: The Rt. Rev. Francis Thomas McDougall
dates: (1817–1886)
---

Bishop of Labuan and Sarawak

He married Harriette Bunyon in 1843.

He returned to England in the late 1860s and eventually became a Canon of Winchester Cathedral.
